2025 Audio-Video Fixed Media

Venerdì sera a letto presto

Friday night going to bed early — Audio-Video Fixed Media

Video

Complete work (7 minutes)

Concept

The artist disrupts the ontological paradigm of "the couch as device of stasis" through neural network-assisted domestic audiovisual wandering. The camera, traditionally deputized to record reality, is reconfigured as sentient interface generating a para-medieval bestiary capable of suspending distinction between quotidian and hieratic.

The work produces domestication of the sublime: corridor becomes nave, kitchen an apse, bedsheets a palimpsest.

The author's precariously choreographic body activates processes of intra-action, converting the house into diegetic ecology etc... etc...

Specifications

Premiere Notte Europea della Ricerca — Piacenza, 27 September 2025
Duration 7 minutes
Format Audio-Video Fixed Media
Tools Wavepilot, TouchDesigner, Ableton Live, Python
